conclusion.guard_task_tariff_dominance: Passed all-history and actual paired checks under the inherited waiting/STOP contract.
conclusion.primary_analytic_increment: negative on the four fixed new configurations
conclusion.statement: The implemented repair safely eliminates no-information SKIP tails. It does not establish analytic-core superiority: the primary D-B is negative, ordinary guarded Qpi has higher correctness and lower measured actor CPU, and two analytic seed37 configurations remain below immediate STOP.

cost.accounting: Whole launcher, scientific child, body, actor and phase timings are nested; do not add them. The inherited training receipt is prior work. This receipt does not claim to cover every historical backbone training expense.

fresh_child_process.includes: Fresh child interpreter startup/imports/verification/all evaluation/serialization/exit; nested actor times are not added again.

inherited_R12_control_training.includes: child startup, training, all raw evidence and final receipt; outer receipt excluded

cost.thread_observation_scope: Actual supervisor process; the frozen supervisor creates the scientific child with the same Python executable and inherited environment, without an override.
cost.timing_interpretation: Shared-host single confirmation. CPU changes are descriptive, not established statistical speedups. Lightweight behavior is unchanged yet its measured CPU differs, exposing measurement variability.

design.aggregation: Exact task metrics are equal means across the 3 fit seeds x 4 fixed configurations per core. The four configurations are conditions, not independent trained replicates. Actor timings are means over paired sampled trajectories.
design.tasks: Finite synthetic binary raw-evidence task with STOP/READ/SKIP and public schedules/costs.
design.uncertainty: Only three pre-existing fit seeds; report all seed contrasts and their observed range. The observed range is not a confidence interval or population significance result.

fixed_strong_control_comparison.interpretation: The small positive matched-Qstar contrast cannot be used to conceal the stronger retained ordinary Qpi result. No model was newly selected for deployment from these results.

limitations: Four fixed synthetic configurations, three inherited fit seeds, six width-16 checkpoints; no claim about arbitrary tasks or natural-population performance.
Both content backbones and all four base controllers remain frozen; there is no new joint content/control training.
The analytic content operator is the inherited fixed-parameter renewal gate, not full financial He-Xiong distribution propagation or a learned free-boundary QVI.
TailStop proof requires deterministic policies, unchanged h during SKIP, STOP readout depending only on h, public finite schedule and nonnegative SKIP fees.
Independent actual-prefix checks cover root and one selected occupied intermediate prefix per case. Full-history numerical values and this bounded actual-execution sample are different evidence.
Critic scores are unchanged; their calibration is measured against the transformed policy's Qpi. Policy improvement does not imply perfect critic calibration.
Abstract tariff savings do not imply reduced CPU. Guarded matched-Qstar increased measured actor CPU on both cores.
Old R12 48-case algebraic diagnosis is explicitly retrospective and remains separate from this new confirmation.
The prior positive R12 D-B on eight different configurations cannot be carried forward as the result of this four-configuration confirmation.
Device energy, GPU/fused accelerator performance, production latency and foundation-network scaling are unmeasured.

primary_factorial.policy: Every arm uses the same declared TailStop transformation; A/C lightweight, B/D selected inherited Qpi.

scope: Independent machine-readable aggregation of the completed R13 value confirmation only. No new experiment, fitting, policy selection or frozen-source modification.

units.actor_cpu_ms_per_trajectory: Milliseconds of measured actor CPU per paired real trajectory, including wrapper policy calls, raw accesses, content steps, guards and evidence hashing. Model loading, graph construction and gzip I/O are in the separate whole-process receipt.
units.correctness: Probability, not percent. Exact model expectation over raw observation histories.
units.energy: Joules unobserved; null is not zero.
units.max_rss: KiB, maximum single child process RSS.
units.process_cpu: Seconds of full fresh scientific child process CPU; startup through exit.
units.return: Dimensionless abstract task utility: expected terminal correctness minus expected READ and SKIP tariffs. CPU/energy are not included in this utility.
